ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-06-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Shin Geng Lin was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor Yao Juan Lin, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner and the minor were placed under oath and examined.
Qi Ling Wu, the minor's mother, was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Stanley Lam.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Jenny Lam.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
